title: 第2112章 你这都用概念背刺我了你还不是概念级第2111章 这是个果盘儿
slug: 我只想毁灭宗门咋逆天成神了
lines: 此时随着众多的昊天圣地大佬品尝完肘子，也终于确定了这银盘的真正作用。
此物绝对是超超神器级别的存在，此物的效果已经超越了古往今来所有的炼器！
这已经不是神师的能力，这可能真的是概念级的能力了，欧阳明凭借此物虽然不一定完全踏入概念级，但是此物一出，欧阳明将创造全新的炼器神话，距离那从未有过的概念级恐怕也只有半步之遥了！
此物的原理很简单……赋予任何落在上面的食物灵力！
银盘吸收天地间的灵力自己积蓄能量，随后给放在上面的食物赋予灵力，而当银盘之上的灵力消耗干净以后，它会进入一段时间的冷却期，也就是再次储存灵力的时间。
等储存满了之后就会进入最早的发光状态。
这听起来好像没有什么作用是吧？
可恰恰相反，这东西的作用甚至超越一切！
因为你要明白，这世间，拥有灵气的食物本就很稀少，只有一些天材地宝的灵果才有可能拥有灵力，或者是种植出来的那些灵米可以蕴含灵力。
可是天材地宝的灵果不用多说，正常修者根本没有什么机会得到。
而即便是低级一些的灵米虽然有木越国进行种植，但是说实话，灵米的产量还是一般，即便是木越国开荒了无数的灵田，种植了无数的灵米，但目前而言，灵米的产量最多就是供给一些大宗的弟子，中小宗派的弟子或许可以吃上一些，但不可能当做口粮。
普通富贵人家，偶尔吃上一次，那都是谢天谢地了，毕竟这玩意儿的价格摆在那里呢！
所以因为灵米的限制原因，想要完全普及，难度非常巨大！
所以正常情况下除非是昊天圣地的弟子，哪怕是武帝城的弟子，也是灵米搭配着一些正常的食物来进行充饥的！
修者在达到一定品级之后是可以辟谷，但通常修者不会完全辟谷，可是辟谷是指的你可以不吃东西也饿不死，但并不代表你不会有饥饿感啊！
甭管你是什么级别，只要你还有身躯，你都会有饥饿感，所以很少有修者可以完全无视饥饿感什么都不吃的。
毕竟饥饿感是身体的自然反应，只要身体还在就不会完全消失。
世间有句话叫做人吃五谷杂粮就没有不生病的。
其实这句话说明了一个问题，五谷杂粮也好，其他的肉食蛋奶也罢，无论是什么食物，无论听起来多么健康的食物，其实本身也会有一些杂质，而这些杂质，其实也是会在无形之中对人产生损害和影响的。
高品级的修者可以通过一些手段将这些杂质想办法排出体外，但普通人是肯定做不到的。
为什么同样都是人，却分三六九等？
关于这个问题，何长老还真研究过。
天赋天赋，天虽然赋予了一部分，但是还有一部分其实源自于你的父母以及祖辈。
越是强者，结合之后所生出来的孩子往往也越是强大！
你看到四洲一些突然崛起的家族，为什么会出现后代越来越不行的情况？
其实道理很简单，一个突然崛起的家族可能是因为出现了一位强者，这位强者的父母有可能是普通人，而他可能是在机缘巧合之下诞生出来的体质强悍的存在。
但是因为祖上体质一般的原因，所以他的后代可能并不会完全继承他强大的体质。
所以很多人都说过，突然崛起的家族，算不得豪门，所谓的豪门，至少要有十代以上的传承。
传承二字不光是修为，同样也是体质的传承。
一代代体质都在改变，最终十代人之后，所诞生出来的人体质会越来越好，所以这也是为什么那些豪门的孩子看起来为什么都那么的优秀！
而决定体质很大的原因其实就是你平时的吃喝！
这看起来好像不是很重要，可实际上却非常重要，因为这在无形之中可能就影响到了你看不到的地方。
这也是为什么豪门每年都拿出无数的资源去购买各种灵米，从小给自家的孩子吃灵米的重要原因！
因为除了灵米之外，其他正常的饭菜食物，全部都会产生杂质，这些杂质或许一时半会儿看不出什么，但经年累月之下，这些杂质却会决定很多人不同的命运！
而如今，欧阳明的银盘的能力不光是给食物附加灵力那么简单……最关键的是，它在附加灵力的同时驱散掉了食物之中本身的杂质，把普通食物变成了灵米一样的存在！
而且它跟灵米不一样，灵米种植需要很多的成本，可是欧阳明打造的银盘，一旦成型之后就再也不需要任何成本，只要食物上去就可以赋予灵力驱散杂质，同时银盘可以自己吸收天地之力，可以自己充能！
完全不需要再耗费任何的资源！
这东西绝对是概念级的存在。
这一只银盘或许算不得什么，可是你想象一下，如果有朝一日，全四洲所有人都可以使用银盘，哪怕是那些银盘的等级没这么高，哪怕只是最低级的，就算是无法给食物附加灵力，但只要能够消除掉食物之中的杂质。
那么至少可以保证你吃任何食物或许没有加成，但也不会堆积杂质！
一代人两代人或许看不出什么，但是三代五代之后，就完全不一样了！
content_en:
At this time, as many Haotian Holy Land bosses tasted the elbow, they finally determined the true function of this silver plate.
This object is definitely a super artifact level existence, and its effect has surpassed all the weapon refiners in the past and present!
This is no longer the ability of a divine master, this may really be a conceptual level ability. Although Ouyang Ming may not necessarily reach the conceptual level with this item, once this item comes out, Ouyang Ming will create a new weapon refining myth, and he is probably only half a step away from the never-before-seen conceptual level!
The principle of this thing is simple... it gives spiritual power to any food that falls on it!
The silver plate absorbs the spiritual power between heaven and earth to accumulate its own energy, and then gives spiritual power to the food placed on it. When the spiritual power on the silver plate is exhausted, it will enter a cooling period, which is the time to store spiritual power again.
When the storage is full, it will enter the earliest glowing state.
This doesn't sound like it will do anything, right?
But on the contrary, the effect of this thing even surpasses everything else!
Because you have to understand that in this world, food with spiritual energy is very rare. Only some spiritual fruits of heaven and earth treasures may have spiritual power, or the spiritual rice grown can contain spiritual power.
But needless to say, normal cultivators have no chance of obtaining the spiritual fruits of heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
Even though the lower-level spiritual rice is cultivated by Mu Yue Kingdom, to be honest, the output of spiritual rice is still average. Even though Mu Yue Kingdom has opened up countless spiritual fields and planted countless spiritual rice, at present, the maximum output of spiritual rice is to supply some large-scale disciples. Disciples of small and medium-sized sects may be able to eat some, but it cannot be used as rations.
Ordinary wealthy people would be grateful if they could eat it once in a while. After all, the price of this thing is so high!
Therefore, due to the limitations of Lingmi, it is very difficult to fully popularize it!
So under normal circumstances, unless you are a disciple of Haotian Holy Land, even if you are a disciple of Martial Emperor City, you need spiritual rice mixed with some normal food to satisfy your hunger!
Cultivators can be fasted after reaching a certain level, but usually cultivators will not be able to completely fast. However, fasting means that you can not eat but still starve, but it does not mean that you will not feel hungry!
No matter what level you are, as long as you still have a body, you will feel hungry, so there are very few cultivators who can completely ignore hunger and eat nothing.
After all, hunger is a natural reaction of the body and will not completely disappear as long as the body is there.
There is a saying in the world that no one will get sick if he eats whole grains.
In fact, this sentence illustrates a problem. Whether it is whole grains, other meats, eggs, or milk, no matter what kind of food it is, no matter how healthy it sounds, there will actually be some impurities in it, and these impurities will actually cause damage and influence to people invisibly.
High-level cultivators can find ways to expel these impurities from the body through some means, but ordinary people are definitely unable to do so.
Why are we all the same people, but divided into different categories?
Elder He has actually studied this issue.
Although some of your talents are given by God, some of them actually come from your parents and ancestors.
The stronger the person, the more powerful the child will be after their union!
You see some families in the four continents that suddenly rise, why do their descendants become increasingly poor?
In fact, the reason is very simple. The sudden rise of a family may be due to the emergence of a strong man. The parents of this strong man may be ordinary people, and he may be born by chance with a strong physique.
However, due to the average physique of his ancestor, his descendants may not fully inherit his powerful physique.
Therefore, many people have said that a family that suddenly rises cannot be considered a wealthy family. The so-called wealthy family must have a heritage of at least ten generations.
The word inheritance is not only the inheritance of cultivation, but also the inheritance of physique.
The physique is changing from generation to generation, and eventually after ten generations, the physique of the people born will be getting better and better, so this is why the children of those wealthy families look so good!
The biggest factor that determines your physical fitness is actually your usual food and drink!
This may not seem very important, but it is actually very important, because it may affect things you can't see.
This is also an important reason why wealthy families spend countless resources to buy various spiritual rice every year and feed their children spiritual rice since childhood!
Because except for spiritual rice, all other normal meals will produce impurities. These impurities may not be noticeable for a while, but over time, these impurities will determine the different fates of many people!
But now, the ability of Ouyang Ming's Silver Plate is not just as simple as adding spiritual power to food... the most important thing is that while adding spiritual power, it dispels the impurities in the food itself, turning ordinary food into a spiritual rice-like existence!
And it is different from spiritual rice. The cultivation of spiritual rice requires a lot of costs, but the silver plate created by Ouyang Ming does not require any cost once it is formed. As long as the food is put on it, it can be given spiritual power to dispel impurities. At the same time, the silver plate can absorb the power of heaven and earth and can recharge itself!
No need to waste any resources at all!
This thing is definitely a conceptual level.
This silver plate may not be anything, but imagine if one day, everyone in the four continents can use a silver plate, even if the grade of those silver plates is not that high, even if it is only the lowest level, even if it cannot add spiritual power to food, as long as it can eliminate impurities in the food.
Then at least it can ensure that any food you eat may not be added, but it will not accumulate impurities!
title_en: Chapter 2112 You are backstabbing me with concepts. You are not yet at the concept level. Chapter 2111 This is a fruit plate.
